**Draft Reply:**

---

To: ahmed.rahman@vendorxyz.com
Subject: Re: Steel Delivery Update — Project Alpha

Dear Ahmed,

Thank you for your notification regarding the delay to Order #ST-2026-0847 (150 metric tons of structural steel).

We acknowledge the revised delivery date of April 19, 2026. Please note that per our contract terms, the maximum allowable delay is 7 days. The current delay of 14 days exceeds this limit by 7 days, which would trigger the penalty clause at 0.5% of order value per day.

Given the impact on our Foundation milestone and downstream activities, we request:

1. Written confirmation of the revised delivery date
2. Weekly progress updates as you mentioned
3. Your plan to absorb or mitigate the applicable delay penalties

Please advise at your earliest convenience so we can adjust our project schedule accordingly.

Regards,
[Your Name]
Project Alpha — Procurement Team

---
